description: Humai metadata overlay for vendored free-exercise-db rows whose upstream fields are null. Applied by import-exercises.js before upsert; does NOT modify the pristine source. Every entry cites the source-internal convention used.

patches.name: Bodyweight Walking Lunge
patches.basis: name + instructions: unweighted stepping lunge; source encodes all unweighted lower-body moves as 'body only'

patches.name: Decline Push-Up
patches.basis: push-up family; box is positional — source encodes Push-Ups/variants 'body only'

patches.name: Floor Glute-Ham Raise
patches.basis: floor/partner variant of Glute Ham Raise; no machine present — 'body only' is closest source value

patches.name: Inverted Row
patches.basis: bodyweight-resistance row on fixed bar — same convention as Pullups/Chin-Up ('body only')

patches.name: Prone Manual Hamstring
patches.basis: partner-applied manual resistance — 'other' is the source value for nonstandard implements

patches.name: Scapular Pull-Up
patches.basis: bodyweight-resistance pull-up variant — same convention as Pullups

patches.name: Double Kettlebell Windmill
patches.basis: sibling 'Kettlebell Windmill' is 'compound' (note: 'Advanced Kettlebell Windmill' is 'isolation' — upstream inconsistent; matched the non-advanced sibling)

patches.name: Kettlebell Figure 8
patches.basis: dynamic multi-joint movement pattern; consistent with source's compound tagging of dynamic KB moves

patches.name: Reverse Hyperextension
patches.basis: closest sibling 'Hyperextensions (Back Extensions)' is 'isolation'; fixed-arc machine movement

patches.name: Side Bridge
patches.basis: static trunk hold — siblings 'Plank' and 'Butt Lift (Bridge)' are 'isolation'
